# Indikator 15: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som udvikler hjertesvigt inden for 1 år

This supplementary indicator tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who develop heart failure within one year, measuring a major clinical complication.

## Mentions

- Page 79: "Supplerende indikator: Hjertesvigt efter atrieflimren. Indikator 15: Andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som udvikler hjertesvigt inden for 1 år" [^src1]

## Relationships

- [[atrieflimren|Atrieflimren]] — measures-outcome-in [^src1]. Evidence: "Indikator 15 measures heart failure development in newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients within 1 year" (Page 79)
- [[hjertesvigt|Hjertesvigt]] — is-tracked-by (incoming) — "Heart failure is the outcome measured by Indicator 15" [^src1] (Page 79)

## Claims

- For Indicator 15 (heart failure in newly diagnosed patients), Denmark overall showed 1,322 / 21,804 patients (6.1%, 95% CI 5.7-6.4) developing heart failure in the period 01.07.2022 - 30.06.2023 ([[indikator-15-heart-failure-newly-diagnosed]], [[danmark|Danmark]], [[hjertesvigt|Hjertesvigt]])
- Region Hovedstaden reported 370 / 5,905 patients (6.3%, 95% CI 5.7-6.9) with heart failure for Indicator 15 ([[indikator-15-heart-failure-newly-diagnosed]], [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[hjertesvigt|Hjertesvigt]])
- Region Sjælland reported 252 / 3,590 patients (7.0%, 95% CI 6.2-7.9) with heart failure for Indicator 15 ([[indikator-15-heart-failure-newly-diagnosed]], [[sjaelland|Sjælland]], [[hjertesvigt|Hjertesvigt]])
- Region Syddanmark reported 283 / 4,972 patients (5.7%, 95% CI 5.1-6.4) with heart failure for Indicator 15 ([[indikator-15-heart-failure-newly-diagnosed]], [[syddanmark|Syddanmark]], [[hjertesvigt|Hjertesvigt]])
